name: Simplex Castings Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1971, Simplex Castings Ltd is a manufacturer of castings and engineering solutions.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
SCL is in the heavy engineering castings business. It manufactures heavy engineering castings in grey cast iron, alloy cast iron, and stainless steel. The company is a complete one-stop shop for all engineering components manufacturing needs, castings, fabrications, forging, machining, assembly, and equipment 
building, in-house testing, EPC division, and designing facility.

pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
Company has delivered good profit growth of 20.7% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Stock is trading at 5.28 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Debtor days have increased from 76.0 to 109 days.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -3.43%
Working capital days have increased from 34.8 days to 67.6 days
